description: Only the product recalls changed since your cursor (delta of /v1/recalls). Keyset delta of /v1/recalls: pass since=<next_cursor from your last call> and get only the product recalls added or changed after it, plus changed_count and a new next_cursor. Omit since once to bootstrap. Cursors are stable across restarts. Poll the free sibling /v1/recalls/changes for counts and pay only when there is something to fetch. [HTTP: GET /v1/recalls/delta · price $0.005 via x402 · docs https://x402-factory.com/docs/gov.recalls.delta]

since.description: Opaque cursor from a previous next_cursor; omit once to bootstrap a cursor at now
